name: fuel
description: Above the prompt only when you are near a limit: context window, plan limits with reset countdowns and an estimated cache age, as clay-to-red gradient gauges; a Compact button; /fuel any time for a one-line summary

cache_warm_minutes.title: Cache warm window (minutes)
cache_warm_minutes.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a response: 5 for the default cache, 60 for the 1-hour cache. The cache gauge is an estimate from this.

context_threshold.title: Show at context %
context_threshold.description: The band appears once the context window is at least this full.

limit_threshold.title: Show at plan limit %
limit_threshold.description: The band appears once any plan limit (5-hour, 7-day, spend) is at least this used.
